summary: Computes a weighted ratio from a two-dimensional lookup table. Takes a row index a2 and a column index a3, bounds-checks them against the row count this[0] and column count this[2], reads an 8-byte table entry per axis from the row array this[1] and column array this[3] (base value at offset +0, weight at offset +4), and returns (scaleFactor * rowWeight * colWeight) / (rowBase * colBase * divisor) when the divisor this[4] is positive. Returns 0.0 on any failed bounds check or non-positive base/divisor value. Name carried by the legacy ABI symbol (RatioCalculator); existing analysis describes it as a 2D table ratio calculator used by session-state indexed lookup and vehicle setup value formatting.

operations.description: Row index lower bound: if a2 < 0, return 0.0 (zero sentinel from the read-only double global dbl_59E430).
Row index upper bound: if a2 >= this[0] row count, return 0.0.
Column index lower bound: if a3 < 0, return 0.0.
Column index upper bound: if a3 >= this[2] column count, return 0.0.
Resolve the row entry: row array base = this[1], entry at base + 8*a2, and read its base value v4 (offset +0).
If the row entry base value v4 is <= 0, return 0.0.
Resolve the column entry: column array base = this[3], entry at base + 8*a3, and read its base value v7 (offset +0).
If the column entry base value v7 is <= 0, return 0.0.
If the divisor this[4] is <= 0, return 0.0.
Compute the weighted ratio: (this[5] scale * rowWeight(+4) * colWeight(+4)) / (rowBase * colBase * this[4] divisor).
Return the computed ratio, or 0.0 when any of the guards fails.
